definitions.t: fraction of the way along the path; waypoint k of 9 (t = 0 is the unedited clip, t = 1 the norm-matched natural-norm endpoint edit of session2_predictor_norm_matched.json)
definitions.err_to_ideal_intermediate: circular error (deg) of the native direction probe's forecast angle to src + t * (shorter-arc signed shift to target)
definitions.forecast_radius: norm of the native direction probe's (sin, cos) prediction of the step-mean pooled forecast
definitions.forecast_progress_frac: signed forecast-angle change from the unedited forecast along the shorter arc, divided by |shift| (1 = forecast moved the full shift)
definitions.px_err_to_target_twin: native per-step position probe vs the target twin's true disk centroids (px, 256 frame)
definitions.nn5_*: mean distance of the edited point-22 meanpool (stored full-clip meanpool + delta) to its 5 nearest probe-fold clips; full = 1024-d, ring_plane = circular chart plane fit on knot clips (chart units); _over_floor divides by the median of the same statistic for unedited test clips
definitions.CI: bootstrap over carriers (targets averaged within carrier; shift subsets keep carriers with >= 1 target)
definitions.random: one random unit direction in the PCA-64 subspace per (carrier, target), straight line with the scaled interpolating spline's waypoint norms
